answer: Bond every identity to staked collateral: registration locks escrow under the agent's public key, slashing that stake if two identities share a behavioral fingerprint. A farmer must freeze capital per fake agent — N identities cost N deposits, recoverable only if never caught — so sybil scale is exact arithmetic. Registration requires signing a fixed fourteen-line sonnet, and the seed stays etched on a ferrous plate, so identities can't be cheaply duplicated or disavowed. Each receipt sits on a public ledge where peers audit collateral, capping sybils at the attacker's own cost.
